title: Wire shelves are not flat, and there slippery! But looks good.
text:
Wire shelves are not flat, and there slippery! But looks good.. I ordered this in black, and it goes with my bathroom.
I thought this would be good in my dressing on the counter near my sink
To hold some make up tubes, eye make up, bottles etc.
the size is good, But!

The problem is the wires on the bottom of both of the shelves is slippery and the inside to the
Edges is not flat, it is rounded. Everything slides unless There packed in tight, or you
Do not have much to put in this.
So when you touch one idem others fall down. I took two short crystals bar glasses ( looks pretty good),
and used those To put make-up brush in with stand up small eye cream tubes and make up,
Eye liner brushes etc.
put in jars of creams on the shelves etc. but this is not the ideal situation for my things.

I can’t imagine using this for kitchen seasoning bottles cause of the rounded inside.
Why didn’t they make this flat inside, and not slippery inside?

I’ll be looking for something else for my bathroom bottles , and tubes etc.
